free_data: examples/configs.py moderate; far_radius0,inner_flatten1, original .045/.09 and .03/.06 inner windows; all masses/spins/boosts/f fixed
experiment: One matched polar-doubling solve, not a three-level acceptance sequence; refined grid prolongs the converged square iterate within the identical basis/map.

criteria.success: Both converged plus >=4x reduction of g1 physical-equivalent momentum RMS on the identical comparison grid AND fixed bulk Cartesian physical M RMS.
criteria.failure: Either momentum norm improves by less than2x, or a growing angular tail; solver failures remain explicit.
criteria.inconclusive: Improvement between2x and4x, or verifier/solver failure prevents attribution.

note: Diagnostic thresholds declared before runs. Existing physical/charge/axis/covariance/horizon acceptance thresholds are unchanged. No nonlinear filtering or row-weight changes.
